title: patches/rust-oscore-local.patch and README linkage stale after oscore v0.1.2 vendoring
description: Artifact governance from 3x codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-ythw: (1) rust/Cargo.toml [patch.crates-io] now points at the vendored in-tree rust/crates/oscore (v0.1.2, commit 61540bccff) - nothing applies patches/rust-oscore-local.patch anymore, and the patch no longer applies at external clone HEAD 76cee08 (26f2b32 superseded the design: dedicated received_response_piv window instead of response_window+mark_response_used). Decide: delete the patch file, or mark it historical. (2) patches/README.md:33-39 says upstream 'does not ship yet' - false since v0.1.2 shipped begin_unprotect_observe_response and master_secret; the patch-apply instructions would mislead a future session. Rewrite the section for the vendored reality. (3) The external clone keeps uncompiled dead modules (src/context.rs, protect.rs, unprotect.rs, option.rs, crypto.rs, group.rs, types.rs, tests.rs) with pre-fix window-helper copies that mislead audits - delete or wire them (upstream push needs Mark's authorization). (4) Vendored crate: ordinary explicit-PIV responses are now window-checked too but no test pins reordered-but-fresh ordinary responses (observe path has observe_replay_window_accepts_out_of_order_once_and_rejects_old; add the ordinary twin). (5) Vendored crate: add debug_assert!(diff < WINDOW_SIZE) before the unguarded 1 << diff shifts (mark_received_response_piv else-branch ~1500, mark_response_used ~1432) - safe today via the begin->commit invariant, one refactor from a panic. (6) lichen-node secure.rs: a replayed committed CON notification missing the single-slot completed_confirmable cache is dropped silently (no ACK/RST) - harmless while ObserveServer backpressure permits only one outstanding CON; document the coupling or add a MID-keyed ACK cache if multiple outstanding CONs are ever allowed.
